tooltip: Stream Mode – Selects master or trigger streaming.
Camera Mode – Selects IR, RGB, or simultaneous IR-RGB output.
Strobe Mode – Enables or disables the strobe output.
Flip Mode – Flips the image horizontally and/or vertically.
Brightness For IR – Adjusts IR-image brightness.
Contrast For IR – Adjusts IR-image contrast.
Gain For IR – Adjusts IR-image gain.
Minimum Exposure Compensation – Sets the minimum exposure limit in microseconds.
Maximum Exposure Compensation – Sets the maximum exposure limit in microseconds.
Default – Restores extension controls to their default values.
Serial Number – Reads the camera serial number.
Firmware Version – Reads the camera firmware version.
